result.topic_en: Gauss records dated time/value observations, a table of stellar magnitude brightness ratios, the mirror dimensions of his first heliostat, and a formula with logarithmic calculations for the brightness of a heliotrope image at a distance Δ (Hohehagen–Brocken, Hohehagen–Inselsberg), compared with Aldebaran.

methods.what: Table of brightness ratios between successive stellar magnitudes (ratio about 2.3 per magnitude)
Mirror area of the first heliotrope as the product of its side lengths
Brightness of a heliotrope at distance Δ: inverse-square law combined with exponential atmospheric extinction, in units of Aldebaran's brightness
Logarithmic evaluation of the brightness formula for the Hohehagen–Brocken distance
Logarithmic evaluation of the brightness formula for the Hohehagen–Inselsberg distance

items.quote: Diese Formel setzt voraus eine Fläche von 221 Quadrat[?] Millimeter ohne Rücksicht auf Folieschwächung[?] u. Neigung[?]
items.english: This formula assumes an area of 221 square millimetres, without regard to weakening by the foil and to inclination.
